description: A shell script for testing Git worktree operations involving skip-worktree, including setup, read-tree updates, index setup, and sparse checkout scenarios.

methods.name: setup_absent
methods.description: Prepares a test environment with a file marked as absent in the index.

methods.name: setup_dirty
methods.description: Prepares a test environment with a file marked as dirty in the index.

methods.name: test_dirty
methods.description: Verifies the dirty state of a file in the index.
